endorsements.quote: The solution lies not in banning technology, but in fostering critical evaluation and mandatory specialist verification of AI-generated outputs.
However, the final interpretation of the data, responsible clinical judgement, and, most importantly, the empathic human connection must remain in the hands of the clinician.

unlisted_practices: Establish clear regulatory and ethical frameworks defining responsibility for AI-assisted decisions in psychiatry before implementing agentic AI.
Implement critical thinking development programs and cognitive remediation as a primary preventive strategy against digital psychopathology.
Adopt blended-care models that integrate digital tools into face-to-face clinical practice.
Implement digital technologies in psychiatry through a phased roadmap of preclinical validation, pilot implementation, scaling, and institutionalization stages.

screen.reason: This is an editorial discussing the conceptual and governance challenges of AI in psychiatry, proposing a hybrid model and emphasizing human-in-the-loop oversight.
